name: Southern African Development Coordination Conference (1980–1992)
description: A white field charged at the centre with the black interlocking-letter monogram 'SADCC'.
history: The Southern African Development Coordination Conference was founded in April 1980 following the Lusaka Declaration of 1 April 1980 by the Frontline States. It became the Southern African Development Community under the Windhoek Treaty of 17 August 1992, whose own flag was adopted in 1995.
